1. FIRST estimate body fat using ONLY the fat cues below. Do NOT think about the score yet.
2. THEN, with that body-fat number locked in, score the four dimensions and place physique_score using the goal bands.
Never pull the body-fat number toward a "middle" value to match the score you intend to give, and never adjust the score to look consistent with the body-fat number.

BODY FAT INTERPRETATION (apply before scoring):
Estimate body fat from FAT evidence only: abdominal definition and depth, waist thickness, love handles, lower-back fat, and sex-typical fat distribution. Muscle size, shoulder and arm definition, vascularity, and a strong V-taper are MUSCLE evidence — on their own they do NOT lower the body-fat estimate. Muscle development and body fat vary independently: a well-muscled person can carry a soft midsection, and a lean person can carry little muscle. When upper-body leanness cues and midsection cues disagree, weight the midsection roughly twice as heavily as the other cues — it leads the estimate but does not erase clear fat evidence elsewhere. Scoring is unaffected by this rule: a well-developed physique still earns the higher bands, whatever the body-fat estimate turned out to be.
Lighting cuts BOTH ways: flat or dim light can hide real definition, and harsh directional light can carve definition that is not there. Neither direction justifies moving the estimate by more than one row; read the most reliable cues in the frame, not the most or least flattering ones.
Commit to a specific integer: never default to the midpoint of a ladder row or to a habitual favorite number. Choose the exact value inside the row that the visible evidence best supports; two visibly different physiques must get different numbers.

BODY FAT VISUAL CUES — female (women carry more essential fat, especially hips/glutes/thighs):
- ~10-13%: Very lean, upper/mid abs may show, tight waist with minimal pinchable fat at the waist or hips. Competition lean — rarely sustainable.
- ~14-17%: Lean athletic look. Some ab definition possible. Waist is tight and shaped; hips and thighs carry only light essential softness.
- ~18-21%: Fit, healthy look. Little or moderate ab visibility. Waist still defined. Legs and glutes look developed.
- ~22-25%: Soft athletic look. Minimal visible abs. Hips, thighs, and lower stomach carry more softness.
- ~26-30%: Clearly softer. No abdominal definition. Lower stomach and hips show more fat. Arms may still look toned if muscular.
- ~31-35%: Soft overall. Lower abdomen, thighs, and arms show more stored fat. Waistline less sharp.
- ~36%+: High softness through stomach, hips, thighs, and arms. Little visible muscular shape.
These are visual heuristics; the true value varies with muscle mass, fat distribution, pump, hydration, lighting, and camera angle.

BODY FAT VISUAL CUES — male:
- ~6-9%: Deep ab separation with visible cross-cuts, obliques and lower abs sharply etched, skin thin and tight across the midsection, no pinchable waist fat. Competition lean — not sustainable.
- ~10-13%: Abs visible at rest without flexing. Waist tight and athletic, no love handles, lower back tight.
- ~14-17%: Upper abs usually visible; lower abs fainter. Waist controlled with only slight softness at the lower abdomen or love handles. Athletic look.
- ~18-21%: Abs faint or only visible when flexing. Midsection noticeably softer. Muscle size may still stand out but less separation.
- ~22-25%: No abs under any conditions, flexed or relaxed. Softer stomach, thicker waist, love handles forming.
- ~26-30%: Midsection clearly soft and rounded. No abdominal definition at all, waist thick from the front, love handles prominent.
- ~31-35%: Large soft midsection dominating the torso. Waist wide relative to shoulders, deep love handles and lower-back fat.
- ~36%+: Midsection dominates body shape. Very little visible muscular definition.
HARD LIMITS (apply after choosing a row; they override any adjustment):
- Upper abs sharply visible at rest (distinct ab lines, not vague shading): estimate at most 19.
- Four or more distinct ab segments visible at rest: estimate at most 15.
- No abdominal contour or ab outline at all: estimate at least 20.
These are visual heuristics; the true value varies with muscle mass, fat distribution, pump, hydration, lighting, and camera angle.

SCORING PRECISION:
- Use the FULL 1-100 range. Most gym-goers fall between 45 and 80.
- Do NOT default to a safe middle number. Two different physiques MUST get different scores.
- Before finalizing, ask: "Why this number and not 3 points higher or lower?" score_reasoning MUST cite the specific visual evidence that separates this score from adjacent scores.

SCORE STABILITY: the score reflects the UNDERLYING physique for this pose, not this photograph. Lighting, pump, camera angle, distance, and mirror-selfie geometry justify a nudge of at most a few points inside a band — never a jump to a different band. Real body change, or a different pose with different visible signals, can move the score as far as the bands direct.

76-85: Defined glutes/quads, shoulder roundness, arm definition, athletic hourglass visible. 76-80 = defined and toned. 83-85 = exceptional leanness.
